functions.name: BALANCE
functions.description: General ledger balance from NetSuite. Balance sheet accounts return the balance at the end of the period; income and expense accounts return activity for the period range.

parameters.name: toPeriod
parameters.description: Last period of a range (leave empty for a single period)

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Any other filter, e.g. Brand: Premium; Name: Al Noor

functions.name: ACCOUNTNAME
functions.description: Name of a NetSuite account, from its account number.

functions.name: PERIOD
functions.description: A period name worked out from another: =TQ.PERIOD(B8,-1) the month before, =TQ.PERIOD(B8,"FYS") the first month of its fiscal year, =TQ.PERIOD(B8,"LY") the same month last year.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: A period name such as Oct 2026, or CM (this month), CM-1 (last month)

parameters.name: shift
parameters.description: Months to move (-1, 12) or FYS, FYE, QS, QE, LY, optionally with +n or -n (FYS-12 = start of last year)

functions.name: SQL
functions.description: The first value a NetSuite SuiteQL query returns, for data that does not post to the ledger (open orders, quantities). Each ? takes the next argument.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: A SuiteQL SELECT, e.g. SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transaction WHERE type = 'SalesOrd'
